overview_description.description:
MVMNT is a TMS company for freight brokers, by freight brokers. The MVMNT platform represents the best of what the industry has learned over the years, giving you everything you need to balance the considerations of Price, Service, and Gross Profit. Brokerage is a business of action. It’s not just about speed – success is about speed in the right direction. You need to be able to act quickly with the right information if you want to maximize gross profit. By taking a brokerage-first approach with its TMS, MVMNT saves you headaches at the load level and the organizational level, freeing up your time to focus on what really matters – your relationships. 

Visit mvmnt.io to schedule time with the MVMNT team for a demo on how they give you control over the inputs to your success.

about_short_description.short_description: MVMNT is a TMS company for freight brokers, by freight brokers.

product.name: MVMNT Transportation Management System (TMS)
product.description: A cloud-based TMS platform designed for freight brokers to manage brokerage workflows, load postings, carrier sourcing, and shipment tracking with real-time integrations and automation.

product.name: RateLens
product.description: A rate comparison and quoting tool that aggregates historical and market freight rates to help brokers generate accurate quotes and analyze pricing.

product.name: Carrier Sourcing Integrations
product.description: Real-time integrations with carrier data providers and load boards to find, vet, and book carriers directly from the TMS.

product.name: Carrier Onboarding and Compliance Integrations
product.description: Integrations with carrier vetting and compliance platforms to onboard, monitor, and manage carrier insurance and authority data within the TMS.

product.name: Load Tracking Integrations
product.description: Integration with load tracking providers to monitor shipment status and provide real-time updates within the TMS and customer portals.

product.name: Factoring Integrations
product.description: Integration with factoring companies like HaulPay and Denim to manage invoice factoring and payment processes directly from the TMS.
